cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 118th Congress's districts (its file says session 118).
rec: Congressional Districts; 2021 Plan, 9 districts (House Bill 1581, P.L. 221-2021)
Indiana General Assembly: House Bill 1581 (2021), redistricting, reprinted 2021-09-23 (copy at All About Redistricting)

One bill (HB 1581) set the congressional, Senate and House plans: passed 2021-10-01, signed 2021-10-04 (secondary source). The bill's digest has the old districts expire on the date of the 2022 general election; the new districts were used from the 2022 primary. P.L. 221-2021 comes from the Indiana Code's history line for the added section; the bill text itself adds chapters 'Congressional Districts; 2021 Plan' (3-3-6), 'House Districts; 2021 Plan' and 'Senate Districts; 2021 Plan'.
